title: The Work Ceases on the House of the LORD
reflectionQuestion: The work of the LORD's house had begun. The foundation had been laid. The adversaries weakened the hands of the people and wrote letters to the king. The king commanded the work to stop. The grass came up among the stones. Many years passed. What is it to live in a city where the unfinished house of the LORD is sitting in the middle of it every day?
